messages:
sam_newhire: Hey folks, quick onboarding benefits/payroll clarifications from week 1 — started 2026-10-05. Two quick things: 1) When exactly does health/dental start? 2) I bought a standing desk mat for $35  how do I get reimbursed? Also curious about PTO accrual cadence and whether observed holidays are prorated for mid-year hires.

sophie (People Ops): Welcome, Sam! :wave: Short answers: coverage is effective the first of the month after a 30-day waiting period unless you selected expedited during enrollment. So with 10/05 start, standard effective date will be 2026-12-01. Desk mat: use Ramp (Onboarding - Home Office) or the expense Google Form if you don't have Ramp access. PTO accrual is prorated based on hire date and you'll see it in Rippling within one pay cycle. Company observed holidays are the full list in the handbook and are not prorated, but floating holidays/PTO are pro-rated.

sam_newhire: wait that sounds like a long delay  30 days from start pushes to Dec 1? I thought 30 days after start would be early November.

sophie (People Ops): Sorry for confusion — timeline: coverage effective date is the first of the month after 30 days. Example: start 10/05 -> 30 days later is 11/04 -> next first of month is 12/01. If you need earlier coverage for an appointment, email benefits@redwood.com and we can send a benefits verification letter.

alec_finance: Reimbursement steps for the mat: 1) Take photo of receipt. 2) Submit via Ramp expense, category = "Onboarding - Home Office", attach receipt. 3) If no Ramp, use the Google expense form (https://forms.gle/expense-redwood) and cc finance@redwood.com. Example memo: "Standing desk mat | $35.00 | 2026-10-06 | Onboarding - Home Office". Finance approval ~3 business days; payout on next payroll unless marked urgent.

mike_payroll: Payroll note: semi-monthly runs on 15th & last day. Since you started 10/05, your 10/31 pay will include prorated earnings 10/05-10/31. PTO accrual posts in Rippling; if you don't see it after one pay cycle, DM People Ops. Observed holidays are company-wide and not prorated; floating days are prorated.

sam_newhire: got it. about taxes  i moved states recently. do i need to submit a new state W-4 or anything separately?

mike_payroll: Update your state withholding in Rippling under Tax Forms. For NY/NJ/CA you may have a state-specific form (IT-2104, NJ-W4, DE-4, etc.) — upload it there. If you moved after your offer, please upload proof of new address in Rippling and submit the state form so withholding is correct for the next run.

sam_newhire: one last Q: are floating holidays auto-assigned or do I request them?

sophie (People Ops): Floating holidays show as a balance in Rippling once PTO is populated; for scheduling, request time off in Rippling and mark as floating holiday. If you want help planning around company closures, ping me and we can suggest dates.

hr-bot: Automated reminder: Complete benefits elections in Rippling by 2026-10-19 to avoid default plan assignment.

sam_newhire: thanks all  submitting the Ramp expense now and finishing benefits tonight. Appreciate it!
